messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: Facetting Percents
parts:
Hi group,

Does anyone know how the following code can be changed or rewritten in order that the within carat percentages add up to one (the group statement in the stat_bin call isn't required, but I included it to clarify that adding it does not solve my problem)?

ggplot(diamonds,aes(carat))+stat_bin(geom="bar",aes(group=carat,y=..count../sum(..count..)))+facet_grid(clarity~.)

Thanks for the help.

Adam Loveland

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Facetting Percents
parts:
Given a fixed binwidth, this is how to do it:

# binwidth = 0.2
ggplot(diamonds, aes(x = carat, y = 0.2 * ..density..)) +
geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.2) +
facet_grid(clarity ~ .)

# binwidth = 0.1
ggplot(diamonds, aes(x = carat, y = 0.1 * ..density..)) +
geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1) +
facet_grid(clarity ~ .)

...since density = relative frequency/binwidth in this context. This
forces you to select a binwidth, which I don't think is a bad thing.

Dennis
